summary: Return the full structured tracking plan for the active project's main branch (events, property library, sources, destinations, routing, mappings, metrics). Pass summary=true for counts only.

params.name: summary
params.doc: If true, return counts instead of the full plan.

returns: { plan, branch, categories[], events[], properties{event[],user[],group[],system[]}, sources[], destinations[], metrics[] } | { plan, counts }

summary: Return a single event with its attached properties and destination mappings. Look up by name or event_id.

params.name: name
params.doc: Event name to look up. Provide name or event_id.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: Event UUID to look up. Provide event_id or name.

returns: { id, name, display_name, description, category_id, tags, trigger_type, trigger_config, purpose, properties[], destinations[] } | { error, error_type:'not_found', message }

summary: Validate the working draft and return a findings report (missing required properties, duplicate names, unrouted events, etc.). Read-only.
returns: { findings[{ severity, code, message, entity_type, entity_id }] }

summary: Create an event on the working draft (main branch). Validated against the schema.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique event name on the branch.

params.name: display_name
params.doc: Human-friendly label.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: UUID of an existing category.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing event. Only supplied fields are changed.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to update.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete an event from the working draft. Also removes all property attachments and destination mappings for that event.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event to delete.

returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Replace the full set of source links for an event (idempotent). Pass an empty sources array to clear all links.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event.

params.name: sources
params.doc: Array of { source_id, implementation_status } objects. implementation_status: planned | implemented | deprecated.

returns: { ok: true, event_id, source_count } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create or update the mapping between an event and a destination (upsert). Controls the event name sent to the destination, property mappings, and enabled state.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event.

params.name: destination_id
params.doc: UUID of the destination.

params.name: dest_event_name
params.doc: Event name as it should appear in the destination (e.g. GA4 event name). Defaults to the plan event name.

params.name: property_mappings
params.doc: Dict mapping plan property names to destination parameter names.

returns: { ok: true, id } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Remove the mapping between an event and a destination.
returns: { ok: true, removed: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create a reusable library property (event/user/group/system). Enum constraints go in constraints.allowed_values (non-empty list).

params.name: constraints
params.doc: { allowed_values?: [...], regex?, min?, max?, format? }

params.name: parent_property_id
params.doc: Parent UUID for object/array members.

returns: { ok: true, id, name, kind } | { error, ... }

summary: Update fields on an existing library property. Only supplied fields are changed.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: UUID of the property to update.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a library property. Also removes all event attachments for this property.
returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Attach a library property to an event (create the event-property link). If the link already exists it is updated.

params.name: override_description
params.doc: Override the library description for this event context only.

returns: { ok: true, id } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Remove a property attachment from an event. Does not delete the property from the library.
returns: { ok: true, detached: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create an event category for grouping events in the tracking plan.

params.name: color
params.doc: Hex color for UI display.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing category.
returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a category. Events assigned to this category will have their category_id cleared.
returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Add a tracking source (SDK, server, app) to the plan.

params.name: platform_type
params.doc: Platform type slug (e.g. ios, android, web, server, warehouse).

params.name: connector_ref
params.doc: Optional reference to a connected source integration.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing source.
returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a source from the plan. Also removes source-destination connections and event-source links.
returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Add a downstream destination (analytics tool, warehouse, CDP) to the plan.

params.name: platform
params.doc: Platform slug (e.g. ga4, amplitude, segment, bigquery, mixpanel).

params.name: platform_account_id
params.doc: Platform-specific account/property ID.

params.name: config
params.doc: Platform-specific configuration dict.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing destination.
returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a destination from the plan. Also removes source-destination connections and event-destination mappings.
returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create a routing link between a source and a destination (events from this source flow to this destination).
returns: { ok: true, id } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Remove a routing link between a source and a destination.
returns: { ok: true, disconnected: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Create a success metric tied to an event and/or property in the tracking plan.

params.name: event_id
params.doc: UUID of the event this metric is based on.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: UUID of the property to aggregate (required for sum/average types).

params.name: filters
params.doc: Filter conditions applied before aggregation.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Update fields on an existing metric.
returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a metric from the plan.
returns: { ok: true, deleted } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Publish the working draft as an immutable version snapshot. Requires project admin (owner/admin) — this is the human approval gate.

params.name: changelog
params.doc: Human-readable summary of this version.

returns: { ok: true, version_id, version_number } | { error: permission_denied }

summary: Render the current working draft as a Markdown document (human-readable tracking plan). Returns the markdown string in the `content` field.
returns: { ok: true, format: 'markdown', content: string }

summary: Create a new feature branch as a copy-on-write fork of an existing branch (default: main). All content is deep-copied with new ids so the branches are fully independent.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique branch name on the plan.

params.name: from
params.doc: Branch id or name to fork from. Defaults to main.

params.name: description
params.doc: Human-readable description of the branch purpose.

returns: { ok: true, id, name } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: List all branches for the active plan. Main branch appears first.
returns: { branches: [{ id, name, is_main, status, review_status, description, base_branch_id, created_at, merged_at }] }

summary: Get details for a single branch by id.

params.name: branch_id
params.doc: UUID of the branch.

returns: { id, name, is_main, status, review_status, description, base_branch_id, created_at, merged_at } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Structural diff of a head branch against a base branch (default base: main). Reports added, removed, and changed entities across events, properties, sources, destinations, metrics, and categories.

params.name: head
params.doc: Head branch id or name to compare.

params.name: base
params.doc: Base branch id or name. Defaults to main.

returns: { events, properties, sources, destinations, metrics, categories: { added[], removed[], changed[] }, summary: { added, removed, changed } }

summary: Merge a feature branch into main (last-writer-wins). Requires project admin (owner/admin). Publishes a new version after merging.

params.name: branch_id
params.doc: UUID of the branch to merge into main.

params.name: changelog
params.doc: Human-readable changelog entry for the published version.

returns: { ok: true, merged_branch, version_number } | { error: permission_denied }

summary: Set the review status of a feature branch (draft, ready_for_review, changes_requested, approved). Cannot be applied to the main branch.

params.name: reviewer_id
params.doc: UUID of the user performing the review.

returns: { ok: true, id, review_status } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Mark a feature branch as abandoned. Cannot be applied to the main branch.
returns: { ok: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Post a comment (or threaded reply) on a tracking-plan entity. Comments are branch-scoped — they live on the branch where they were posted.

params.name: entity_type
params.doc: Kind of entity the comment is attached to.

params.name: entity_id
params.doc: UUID of the entity being commented on.

params.name: body
params.example: This event is missing the currency property.
params.doc: Comment text. Must be non-blank.

params.name: parent_id
params.doc: UUID of the parent comment to reply to (for threaded comments).

params.name: mentions
params.doc: List of user UUIDs mentioned in this comment.

returns: { ok: true, id } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: List comments on the current branch, optionally filtered to a specific entity. Results are ordered by created_at ascending.

params.name: entity_type
params.doc: Filter to comments on this entity type only.

params.name: entity_id
params.doc: Filter to comments on this specific entity UUID.

returns: { comments: [{ id, branch_id, entity_type, entity_id, parent_id, author_id, body, mentions, resolved, created_at, updated_at }] }

summary: Mark a comment as resolved (or unresolved). Defaults to resolved=true.

params.name: comment_id
params.doc: UUID of the comment to resolve.

params.name: resolved
params.doc: Set to false to un-resolve a comment. Defaults to true.

returns: { ok: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Replace the body text of an existing comment.

params.name: comment_id
params.doc: UUID of the comment to edit.

params.name: body
params.doc: New body text. Must be non-blank.

returns: { ok: true } | { error, error_type, message }

summary: Delete a comment. Replies (children) are cascade-deleted automatically.

params.name: comment_id
params.doc: UUID of the comment to delete.

returns: { ok: true } | { error, error_type, message }
